title: Guilt is a relation resulting from sin by eternal law—no new temporal condemning sentence needed
source_text: XII. Reatus autem ille in eo consistit, quod homo per peccatum Majestatem Divinam offendens, obnoxius sit poenis quas Deus justus judex a peccatoribus exigit. Proinde talis reatus est relatio quaedam, quae, posito peccato, in homine resultat, vi legis illius aeternae, qua statutum est ut peccator, quamdiu in peccato manet, subjaceat ejusmodi poenis, & earum debitor apud Deum existat. Nec ad reatum illum producendum opus est praeterea ulla alia Dei actione, quae in tempore ad eum terminetur; aut ut Deus singularem quandam sententiam pronunciet, qua peccator iste declaretur addictus poenis quas peccatum meretur. Relationes enim non producuntur per actus aliquos qui proxime & per se ad illas terminentur, sed ad positionem fundamenti resultant, absque ulla nova alia actione. Ut exempli gratia, statim atque paries albus hic extructus est, hoc ipso exurgit quaedam cum eo similitudo, in omnibus aliis parietibus albis, quantumcunque hinc distantibus: neque opus est alia actione, quae per se & immediate producat tales similitudines.
pass_a_gloss: But that guilt consists in this, that a man, offending the Divine Majesty through sin, is liable to the penalties which God the just judge exacts from sinners. Accordingly such guilt is a certain relation which, sin being posited, results in the man by force of that eternal law by which it is established that the sinner, as long as he remains in sin, is subject to penalties of that kind and exists as their debtor before God. Nor is there need, for producing that guilt, of any further action of God which is terminated to it in time; or that God pronounce some singular sentence by which that sinner is declared sentenced to the penalties sin deserves. For relations are not produced by some acts which are proximately and of themselves terminated to them, but result upon the positing of the foundation, without any other new action. As for example, as soon as this white wall has been built, by that very fact a certain likeness with it arises in all other white walls, however far distant from here; nor is another action needed which of itself and immediately produces such likenesses.
pass_b_english: Guilt = relational liability under eternal law once sin is posited—debtor while he remains in sin.
No extra temporal condemning act required; relations result from the foundation (white-wall likeness).

choices.why: Scholastic account of reatus without new divine act.
rejected: a created quality in the soul
a fresh courtroom sentence each time
